name: zones_t19_parcellize_6x4_residential
description: Conformance test 19 (§7.14 worked example): a 6 × 4 low-density residential zone along a road. Road (8..17, 9); zone 1 on x 10..15, z 10..13; SetOptions(0, 1, 0); lot size forced to width 2, depth 2, minDepth 1, maxDepth 3, block 6 (the harness bypasses DetermineLotSize). ExamineBoundaries gives S = {600, 4, 6, 4}, C = {1, 0, 0, 0}, D = 0, Q = 3, then the zone-1 placeStreets swap gives D = 3, Q = 0, flag 0. Parcellize lays two rows of two lots with one back street. Expected log: lot (10,10)-(11,11) f1, Place(12,10,12,13), lot (13,10)-(15,11) f3, lot (10,12)-(11,13) f1, lot (13,12)-(15,13) f3.
